functions.name: approve_upgrade
functions.doc:
Second approval of an `Upgrade` proposal, sent with the new code (decision 0012).
 The input is borsh `(id: u64, code: Vec<u8>)`, not JSON, so the wasm travels as bytes.
 At 2 of 3 the contract deploys the code to itself and calls `migrate` in one batch,
 and returns that batch. If `migrate` fails the batch rolls back and the old code stays.
 A call on an expired proposal closes it as `Expired` instead of failing.

functions.name: mark_late
functions.doc:
Marks an unpaid bill as late once its due date has passed. Anyone can call it
 (the backend does every hour). A late bill blocks new shipments until it is repaid.

functions.name: migrate
functions.doc:
Runs right after new code is deployed: by a team upgrade in the same batch, or as the
 init call of a deploy with the deployer key. Reads the stored state, converts it when
 the layout changed, and sets `version`. If it fails, the deploy rolls back.

functions.name: new
functions.doc: `team` must be three different accounts. They approve changes 2 of 3.

functions.name: process_queue
functions.doc: Pays queued withdrawals from free cash. Anyone can call it.

functions.name: propose
functions.doc: A team member proposes a change. Their proposal counts as their approval.

functions.name: settle_report
functions.doc:
The shipper decides what to pay after a problem report (decision 0003).
 `driver_amount` is what the driver gets, at most the original advance:
 pay for what arrived, pay in full, or a different amount agreed with the driver.
 The bill becomes `driver_amount / 97.5%`, rounded up, and the driver is paid at once.

functions.name: vote
functions.doc:
Approve or reject an open proposal. Returns the new status.
 A vote on an expired proposal closes it as `Expired` instead of failing.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc:
Withdraws `amount` of the caller's pool value. Pays the free part now and queues
 the rest, which is paid oldest first as bills are repaid.

code_hash.description: Base58 sha256 of the current code. Null until the first team upgrade.

Config.description: Rules the team can change by proposal later. Defaults follow decisions 0002 and 0003.

assistant_raise_bps.description: Most the assistant may raise a limit within 7 days.

max_limit.description: Highest limit the credit assistant may set on its own.

max_share_bps.description: Biggest single bill compared to the pool value.
